record.one_liner: Close provides a REST API, webhooks, OAuth 2.0 and API key auth, and an official MCP server for CRM data and workflows.

auth_methods.quote: Authentication API keys for scripts or OAuth 2.0 for user-facing integrations.

api_type.quote: REST API Reference Full endpoint docs with schemas, examples, and an interactive API explorer.

api_breadth.quote: Push leads, contacts, activities, and custom data into Close from your website or other systems via the REST API .

official_mcp.quote: Power AI agents — Give Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor, and other tools direct access to Close data via the MCP server — no code required.
